pick.title: Who's watching?
pick.introSingle: Everyone in the house can have their own profile — their own Continue Watching, My List, favourites and home screen. Kids profiles only show what's right for their age.

manage.title: Manage profiles
manage.subtitle: Pick a profile to change it.

edit.kidsInfo: Kids profiles see Plex titles up to that rating, age-appropriate Live TV channels, and their own Kids Game Lounge. The adult Game Lounge, Store, Main Apps, Settings, tickets, and Remote Access stay hidden. Their AI is G-rated and helps only with kids shows, movies, channels, and games.
edit.signInForPin: Sign in to your Snow Media account to add a PIN — that's how a forgotten one gets reset. Then Manage profiles brings this box's profiles to the account.
edit.inUseNote: This is the profile in use — switch to another one to delete it.

intro.title: New: profiles for everyone
intro.pointEveryone: Everyone in the house gets their own setup — their own Continue Watching, My List, favourites and home screen.
intro.pointKids: Kids profiles show only kids movies, shows and channels for the age you pick, plus a kids games section (coming soon).
intro.pointSafety: Safety everywhere: movies, shows, Live TV channels and the AI all stay age-appropriate. Add a PIN to any profile if you like.
intro.hint: Set them up any time under Settings → Profiles, or with the profile button at the top of Home.
